# Independent review of the reconstruction-class obstruction

VERDICT: **ACCEPT_C2_RECONSTRUCTION_OBSTRUCTION_AND_W6_CONTROL_ONLY**.
Reviewer: `/root/pairzero_geometry_review`. Date: 2026-09-17.
Scope: bounded isolated analytic PAPER review; **INCOMPLETE_NO_CONSUMABLE_TARGET**.
No correction is required for the reviewed mathematical statements.

## Exact binding and inputs

I read all 186 lines of `RECONSTRUCTION_CLASS_CANDIDATE.md` and independently checked the complete finite-difference argument and the separate w6 control.

- Candidate SHA256: **`9bc6eca8ddc0b5686921364eed293032d7ec5d819823c40a75c795bd951cbb9b`**.
- Candidate size: **8473 bytes, 186 LF**.
- `RECONSTRUCTION_CLASS_PINS.json` SHA256: `935a85e339ad46cc48909c2795a3e77719c13a6f1787d22c50b58c59337749b9`.

All pinned files were rehashed and match:

| docs/Codex/REPORT_2026-09-17_PICKVAR_INTAKE.md | e0ea0c275b5157f6425935440f9a3b70a896a886be29ad0e607ba9ab8649ffb6 |
| docs/routeB_bus/proshka/PROSHKA_RESPONSE_GOAL058_PICKVAR_2026-09-17.md | 3f7a04a92554c36da91c0df87b3ad9345baf9e5b13c029f03df8c1e3c18c5f7a |
| docs/Codex/REPORT_2026-09-17_DIRECT_PICK_BRIDGE.md | f015fc2df3d0a5c1ab86937b2c077495fb104331d50a4153c34bfd8c4184d97d |
| orchestrator/state/CHANNEL_RUNTIME.json | f7bb8eed28bf9b67292f67bbbdde96cecb4baf42e758e0acbb4be34d5baa6418 |

Their previously accepted mathematical scope is reused. This is not a new audit of the old PICKVAR proof, old all-test transfer, or live channel/phase readiness. The current task does not continue the remaining VAR parameter interval.

The local primary `Baricz_Singh_1702.00626.pdf` has SHA256 `992a42316a41b39027377cbb2690b908ee14f3c1e2464b23c9727316d882abc7`; its text has SHA256 `3f09d27198002e3f9d8107cbc9422738b41e015c66ba9763fd8329398b8d2c69`. I reread Lemma 1 on printed p.2, including its explicit entire-order, real-value, and negative-real-zero hypotheses. I also opened the specifically cited [DLMF 5.5.6](https://dlmf.nist.gov/5.5.E6) directly to check Gauss multiplication; no web search or new source hunt was performed.

## R1: the full-source input really has the needed finite-value bound

With the fixed source and probability normalization,

    log rho(s)=log(4pi^2/Z)+(9/2)sqrt(s)-pi exp(2sqrt(s))
                +log Hcal(exp(2sqrt(s))).

The accepted PV5 bounds Hcal above and away from zero, uniformly for its argument at least one. Thus its logarithm is bounded and R1 follows with a genuine O(1) error for the full theta sum. In particular no asymptotic derivative of Hcal or rho is assumed. The physical normalization f and the original V do not enter or change in this calculation.

## R2–R4: exact invariant and closure under variable-parameter limits

For each individual comparison function on s>0,

    log rho_j=log A_j-a_j s^2-b_j s
                 +sum_k alpha_jk log(s+lambda_jk).

Even when lambda_jk=0, each term is smooth at every strictly positive s. The nonnegative real exponents give

    (log rho_j)'''=2 sum_k alpha_jk/(s+lambda_jk)^3>=0.

The threefold fundamental-theorem-of-calculus identity in R3 is exact. There are no boundary terms: the integration cube is compact and stays strictly inside s>0. The polynomial part of degree at most two vanishes under the third forward difference, regardless of the signs or magnitudes of a_j and b_j. A_j contributes only a constant. Integrability of these comparison functions is neither used nor needed.

For a positive pointwise limit rho_*, continuity of the real logarithm at each of the four values yields

    log rho_j(s+kh) -> log rho_*(s+kh), k=0,1,2,3.

Taking this finite linear combination proves R4. No derivative limit, dominated integral, common parameter bound, or uniform control of the number of factors is involved. All parameters may vary with j without restriction beyond the displayed class definition. A positive infinite-product limit of finite members inherits the same invariant; any further positive pointwise limit of such members also inherits it by precisely the same four-value argument. The enlargement to arbitrary real a_j,b_j makes the obstruction stronger and introduces no probability assumption.

The old plus sibling is covered: at finite product order each factor `(1+s/(pi n^2))^2` is `(s+pi n^2)^2` times a positive constant absorbed in A_j. The convergent infinite product is a positive pointwise limit, and its Gaussian term is the allowed linear exponential in s. An added quartic exponential in x is the quadratic exponential in s already included in C2. Positive scalar mass normalization and linear canonical-factor exponential compensators are also absorbed exactly into A_j and b_j.

This establishes the claimed class scope, including unbounded numbers of factors, arbitrarily varying rates and exponents, and all specified source limits. It does not invoke a Fourier-zero-preservation theorem for all of C2; the candidate expressly does not make that claim.

## R5–R6: actual theta violates the invariant without differentiating an error

Expanding the third difference at s=h=R gives

    ell(4R)-3ell(3R)+3ell(2R)-ell(R).

The ell(4R) leading term is `-pi exp(4sqrt(R))`, with coefficient one. After division by that exponential, the other three leading exponentials have strictly negative exponents `(2sqrt(k)-4)sqrt(R)` for k=1,2,3 and tend to zero. The four square-root terms are O(sqrt(R)); the four full-source logarithmic errors are O(1). Both vanish under the same scaling. Therefore the limit in R5 is exactly -pi.

It follows that the third finite difference is strictly negative for all sufficiently large real R. One such R is fixed before taking any approximation limit. Pointwise convergence at the resulting four fixed positive nodes would force its third log difference to be nonnegative by R4, a contradiction. No order of two infinite limits has been exchanged.

Thus the actual rho is not a positive pointwise limit of C2, and cannot be a locally uniform limit of that class. The statement also excludes pointwise reconstruction of q by the corresponding positive quadratic-product weights in x: evaluating such convergence at x=sqrt(s) would give the prohibited convergence of rho. There is no assertion about Fourier-only limits lacking source convergence, arbitrary substitutions, inverse factors, positive sums, or arbitrary other operations.

## Separate w6 control: excluded reconstruction does not exclude real Fourier zeros

For w6(x)=exp(-x^6), the squared-coordinate profile is rho6(s)=exp(-s^3), and its third forward log difference is exactly -6h^3 for every s,h>0. It is therefore outside the same closure. This is a different source and is not an actual-theta counterexample.

In the raw integral domain Re u>-1/2, y=s^3 gives

    D6(u)=(1/3)Gamma((u+1/2)/3).

The domain is correct at zero, and exponential decay pays infinity. For triplication set z=(u+1/2)/3. Gauss multiplication with n=3 reads

    Gamma(3z)=(2pi)^(-1)3^(3z-1/2)
                Gamma(z)Gamma(z+1/3)Gamma(z+2/3).

Since 3z-1/2=u, division and the factor 1/3 give exactly

    H6(u)=2pi 3^(-u-1)
             /[Gamma(u/3+1/2)Gamma(u/3+5/6)].

This checks both the 2pi and the exponent -u-1 in R7 against [DLMF 5.5.6](https://dlmf.nist.gov/5.5.E6). The formula first agrees in the raw integral domain, then supplies its entire continuation; no pole outside that domain is interpreted as an improper integral value.

The two reciprocal-Gamma zero sequences are exactly `-3n-3/2` and `-3n-5/2`. They are disjoint, so every zero is simple, and there are no additional zeros because the exponential factor is zero-free. H6 is real on the real axis and positive for u>=0. Reciprocal Gamma is of order one: its Weierstrass product, split at indices comparable to |u|, bounds the logarithm of the maximum modulus by O(R log(R+2)); the tail costs O(R) and the initial factors O(R log(R+2)). Affine substitutions, the two products and the exponential factor retain order at most one. Thus H6 satisfies every stated hypothesis of the named Laguerre lemma, strictly within order less than two.

Lemma 1 in the pinned Baricz–Singh primary states that the exponential coefficient transform of an entire function of order less than two, real on the real axis and with only negative real zeros, again has only negative real zeros. This classical theorem is an explicit external input, not reproved here. Its input condition is verified directly for H6 and is not assumed for the actual theta H.

The moment identity has no missing factor of two:

    integral_R x^(2n)exp(-x^6)dx
       =integral_0^infinity s^(n-1/2)exp(-s^3)ds=D6(n).

Using the displayed half-integer Gamma identity therefore gives

    H6(n)/n!=4^n D6(n)/(sqrt(pi)(2n)!),
    F6(z)=sqrt(pi)G6(-z^2/4).

This verifies the coefficient and sign in R8. On every compact complex z-set, exp(R|x|-x^6) dominates the Fourier integrand and the absolute even power series, justifying the entire expansion. By the named lemma, every zero of G6 is negative real, and G6(0)=H6(0)>0 excludes a zero at zero. If F6(z)=0 then -z^2/4 is negative real, which forces z to be real. Positive mass normalization changes none of these conclusions.

Accordingly w6 proves the limited diagnostic statement required here: the closed finite-difference invariant is not a necessary property of every positive source with real Fourier zeros. It is an obstruction to this particular reconstruction operation.

## Accepted scope and stop

The accepted result excludes reconstruction of the fixed full theta source by the specified Gaussian/quartic positive-product class and its positive pointwise source limits. It is stronger than failure to tune one fixed Gaussian parameter, but narrower than exclusion of all source-preserving constructions. The separate w6 example shows why that boundary matters.

No imaginary multiplier closure, arbitrary positive-mixture closure, generic PF-to-RH theorem, or unproved source-preserving map is used. No actual global Pick membership, original V sign, original negative V witness, or RH result is obtained. The arithmetic input used in the no-go proof is the full theta tail with a paid bounded error, not a newly discovered property of primes. Canonical admission and any source-sign counter reset remain outside this review.

Only this assigned private review file was written. No agents, numerical source evaluations, quadrature, Lean, publication, external messages, checkpoint scripts, or canonical mutations were used. This bounded review is complete; it authorizes no further task or dispatch.
